Close out your spooky season with a chilling little tale of love, betrayal, and vengeance under the full moon. Streaming everywhere.Just a few days left on the Kickstarter! Preorder Curiosities on there to help support the project and get cool stuff. Killer licks by @twinkletones

item.title: HOLY MACKEREL YO GYS.I was feeling hopeful but maybe a little ne...
item.description: HOLY MACKEREL YO GYS.I was feeling hopeful but maybe a little nervous about reaching our Kickstarter goal in the allotted days. And then you funded it in less than three hours. WHAT?!?The love and support around this project has left me, for once, speechless. Launching the Kickstarter was like walking out onto a dark stage, and then seeing the immediate support pouring in felt like the house lights coming up to reveal a room full of friendly faces. “Thank you” doesn’t quite cut it here. But thank you all the same.Curiosities expansion plans are in order. More curious stuff incoming, musical and otherwise (see the Kickstarter for a more detailed update).Thank you for showing up for this project! 17 days left to preorder Curiosities on Kickstarter, and then the whole thing comes out on Friday the 13th next month. Can’t wait to share it with you.
